availability: Retrospective bar close plus 60 seconds assumption; not verified historical publication
signal: Positive trailing seven-day close return using only bars available before the next daily opening; otherwise cash
execution: Unfunded unconstrained price-exposure indices. Immediate full fractional transitions at assumed opening bid/ask plus slippage and fees. No broker fill, queue, capacity or portfolio claims.
risk_boundary: Indices deliberately omit portfolio caps, stops, deadlines and daily-loss controls. They are NOT executable Kairos strategies and cannot pass the prior execution-validity gate. No production controls are changed.
fee_note: Explicit sensitivity assumptions, not authenticated account fees. Public pair metadata returned empty fee arrays.
primary: Base-assumption momentum mean daily net index return versus cash and passive, for each asset. Gross and stress are descriptive. No parameter search or selection across scenarios.
criterion: Exploratory evidence only if both assets meet sample thresholds, have positive base/stress net index changes and positive adjusted paired lower bounds versus both references. Otherwise report insufficient or unfavorable evidence. Never claim broker profitability.
holdout: None. 2025 is a previously examined market development period, not an independent market sample or new final test.
excluded: All 2026 observations are filtered out before analysis. The final open-to-open return ends on 2025-12-31, avoiding a 2026 endpoint.
